name: mechanism-explainer
description: Show an explainer's outline as a page to approve, then write it with dragon figures and print it to a PDF

interface.longDescription: Writes an explainer of a system, a mechanism, or a piece of research in HTML. It first draws the outline as a light HTML page with a toggle per chapter, the title and every chapter, page, and section opening with its point in one sentence under a short noun heading, and writes nothing before the person approves it. The explainer is one page for five or fewer questions on one kind of material, or an overview page and one page per topic for six or more questions or more than one kind of material, with the mechanism before its records and reference material and a side menu of topics, questions, and the headings of the open page instead of tabs. Each question gets a page: its one-sentence answer, then `####` headings with one figure that follows the flow or the mechanism, at most two, and tables or code where they are enough. The figures come from the dragon notation, and boxes with notes open a card just below them. The skill checks the notation and the layout with dragon, exports the page with dragon, and prints the page to a PDF.
defaultPrompt: Write an explainer of how OAuth sign-in works, starting with its outline
